decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature play and direct damage. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor to apply pressure early on. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury is a powerful finisher that can close out games quickly. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides utility and additional creature support. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of fast creatures and powerful spells.

The primary focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to play aggressively with low-cost creatures and powerful combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge for removal, as well as Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride for efficient creature threats, the deck aims to curve out efficiently and close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of strong card advantage engines like Guide of Souls and the manipulation provided by The One Ring helps to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Static Prison and Blood Moon.

The main focus of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to quickly establish board presence with efficient creatures like Ocelot Pride and Amped Raptor, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to remove threats and deal direct damage. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury serves as a powerful finisher, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support. Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Static Prison helps control the board. The inclusion of The One Ring and Goblin Bombardment provide additional versatility and potential for explosive plays.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and overwhelming the opponent with a mix of powerful creatures and efficient removal spells. The goal is to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison. The inclusion of key cards like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah further enhances the deck's aggressive strategy, while the versatile companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds additional value and synergy to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to close out games swiftly with a relentless assault.

This deck focuses on using a combination of creature removal, counterspells, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy involves using efficient removal like Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters, along with counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation to stop threats before they hit the battlefield. Card advantage is gained through cards like Cling to Dust and Preordain, while Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans to accelerate mana production and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker early in the game. The control aspect comes from spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Sowing Mycospawn provides additional creature control, while Ancient Stirrings helps to find key pieces of the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with huge creatures while keeping them off balance with disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing ramp and control elements to quickly accelerate into powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul and World Breaker. It aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Kozilek's Return and Kozilek's Command while also generating mana efficiently with cards like Talisman of Impulse and Utopia Sprawl. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional utility and value to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressively ramping into Eldrazi threats while disrupting opponents' game plans.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while controlling the board and managing resources efficiently. The combination of ramp and control elements makes this deck a versatile and strong contender in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing +1/+1 counters and artifact creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By maximizing the value of Hardened Scales and Urza's Saga, it aims to generate massive amounts of power on the board. The deck includes a mix of modular creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Hangarback Walker, as well as utility cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and The Ozolith to keep up the pressure. With the right combination of creatures and support cards, this deck can quickly close out games and outpace opposing strategies.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies, utilizing a combination of powerful creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, along with support cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck. The mana base is designed to support a solid curve of threats, with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to ensure smooth mana production. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and direct damage spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Merfolk tribal strategy. By utilizing powerful Merfolk creatures like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, along with disruptive cards like Merfolk Trickster and Vodalian Hexcatcher, this deck aims to control the battlefield while dealing damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Aether Vial, Fatal Push, and Inquisition of Kozilek allows for additional control and removal options, providing the Merfolk tribe with the tools needed to dominate the game.

This deck aims to quickly generate mana with rituals and mana-fixing cards to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. The key strategy is to chain together spells and rituals to generate a large amount of mana and storm count, allowing for explosive turns that can overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Wish allows for flexible toolbox options and the use of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana ramp. The deck is focused on creating a storm of spells that can lead to a quick victory.

The deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Glimpse the Unthinkable while also controlling the board with spells like Fatal Push and Spell Snare. Cards like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity provide additional mill power, while Jace, the Perfected Mind can help with card advantage and controlling the game. The deck utilizes a combination of land destruction and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's strategy and win through decking out the opponent.
